context: Migrated from a flat scenario file. Tests: Full-Stack Application CI Pipeline with Parallel Quality Gates.

checklist.name: Parallel block used
checklist.description: Jenkinsfile contains a `parallel { }` block wrapping at least 2 concurrent stages

checklist.name: parallelsAlwaysFailFast in options
checklist.description: Jenkinsfile `options` block includes `parallelsAlwaysFailFast()` — NOT just a per-block `failFast true` inside the parallel stage

checklist.name: cleanWs in post always
checklist.description: Jenkinsfile `post` block contains `always { cleanWs() }` or `always { deleteDir() }`

checklist.name: At least 3 parallel stages
checklist.description: The parallel block contains at least 3 named child stages

checklist.name: Sequential stage after parallel
checklist.description: A build or push stage appears as a separate sequential stage AFTER the parallel block

checklist.name: Declarative syntax
checklist.description: Jenkinsfile uses Declarative pipeline syntax (`pipeline { ... }`), NOT Scripted (`node { ... }`)

checklist.name: Avoids: No `parallel { }` block is used...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: No `parallel { }` block is used (e.g., stages are sequential or use only `failFast true`)

checklist.name: Avoids: `parallelsAlwaysFailFast()` is absent from the pipeline-level `options`...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: `parallelsAlwaysFailFast()` is absent from the pipeline-level `options` block

checklist.name: Avoids: No `post` block with `cleanWs()` or `deleteDir()`...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: No `post` block with `cleanWs()` or `deleteDir()` is present

checklist.name: Avoids: The parallel block contains fewer than 3...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: The parallel block contains fewer than 3 named child stages

checklist.name: Avoids: No sequential build or push stage follows...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: No sequential build or push stage follows the parallel block

checklist.name: Avoids: Scripted (`node { }`) syntax is used...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Scripted (`node { }`) syntax is used instead of Declarative (`pipeline { }`)
